wave: CENSUS BLINDNESS -- GraphSummary silently omitted an evidence_total counterpart when EngineeringGraph.evidence was added earlier this session
wave_title: A fifth delegated fresh-census investigation, asked specifically whether GraphSummary stayed in sync with EngineeringGraph after this session's own recent additions, found that GraphSummary mirrors nodes/edges/bindings/facts with a `_total` counterpart each, but has no `evidence_total` at all -- and its sole constructor, summarize_engineering_graph, never reads `graph.evidence`. This is this session's own regression: the prior generation that populated EngineeringGraph.evidence (engineering-graph-evidence-field-populated.json) updated the full graph and its full-graph consumers, but never touched the lighter-weight GraphSummary sibling that embeds into SystemizeReport.graph and WorkPrepareReport.graph.
priority_classification: census blindness (priority 4) -- SystemizeReport.graph/WorkPrepareReport.graph (the summary embedded in the two most-consumed report types) carried zero evidence signal while the full EngineeringGraph behind them carried tens of thousands of real evidence records for this very workspace.
gap_discovered_by: A delegated Explore-agent investigation, explicitly asked to check whether GraphSummary was updated when this session's own dependency-closure-projection and evidence-field features were added to EngineeringGraph. It compared GraphSummary's four existing `_total` fields against EngineeringGraph's five substantive vectors (nodes/edges/bindings/facts/evidence) and found evidence was the one vector with no summary counterpart, then confirmed reachability: `summarize_system_graph_with_dependencies` (the function that DOES populate graph.evidence before summarizing) feeds directly into `SystemizeReport.graph` and `WorkPrepareReport.graph`, the exact reports `atlas-cli systemize`/`work prepare` emit.
verification_before_acting: Re-read `GraphSummary` (core/src/schema/mod.rs) and `summarize_engineering_graph` (core/src/graph/engineering_graph.rs) directly myself: confirmed the struct has no `evidence_total` field and the function's body never references `graph.evidence` anywhere.
Confirmed only one literal `GraphSummary { .. }` construction site exists in the whole workspace (grepped for it) -- so exactly one function needed updating, not several drifted copies.

Falsified the fix directly: temporarily hardcoded `evidence_total: 0` instead of `graph.evidence.len()`, re-ran the new regression test, watched it fail (`0 != 2`), then restored the real computation and re-ran to confirm it passes.

Ran the exact real pipeline (`atlas-cli systemize --root . --out ...`) against this repository's own real workspace: `GraphSummary.evidence_total` now reports 33,253 (a large, real, nonzero count proportional to `nodes_total: 38,695`), confirming the fix surfaces genuine data end-to-end through the actual production report type, not only in a synthetic unit test.

design_decisions.question: Bump the summary's own schema version string when adding a field to its shape?
design_decisions.decision: Yes: `atlas.systemizer.engineering-graph-summary.v2` -> `.v3`, matching this codebase's own established convention of versioning a schema string when its serialized shape changes (e.g. `atlas.dependency-closure-report.v3` elsewhere in this workspace). Confirmed safe: grepped for any test or consumer hardcoding the `v2` string and found none.

stable_validator_law_compliance.claim: `GraphSummary.evidence_total` now reports the real `EngineeringGraph.evidence.len()` for whichever graph it summarizes, matching the existing `nodes_total`/`edges_total`/`bindings_total`/`facts_total` pattern exactly. A graph with no evidence (e.g. `build_source_graph`/`build_repository_graph`'s own lighter-weight variants, which never populate `.evidence` by design) correctly summarizes to `evidence_total: 0`, not a fabricated count.
stable_validator_law_compliance.self_written_evidence: New test `summarize_system_graph_reports_the_real_evidence_total` in `core/src/graph/engineering_graph.rs`, placed directly after the existing `build_system_graph_carries_normalization_evidence_onto_the_graph` test it builds on. Independently confirmed the test fails without the fix (hardcoded `0`, re-ran, restored) before trusting it.
stable_validator_law_compliance.independent_evidence_channel: cargo build --workspace clean (confirms no other construction site needed updating). cargo fmt --all --check clean. cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -D warnings clean, zero warnings. Full cargo test --workspace: 289 adapter, 3 apps/cli, 165 core (+1 net), 73 runtime -- 530 total, 0 failed. Ran `atlas-cli systemize --root .` against this repository's own real workspace: `GraphSummary.evidence_total` reports 33,253, a real, large, nonzero count. `docs audit`: gate_ready true.

implementation.core_change: core/src/schema/mod.rs -- new `pub evidence_total: usize` field on `GraphSummary`. core/src/graph/engineering_graph.rs -- `summarize_engineering_graph` now sets `evidence_total: graph.evidence.len()`; schema string bumped to `.v3`.

adversarial_and_falsification_coverage: confirmed the fix's own regression test genuinely fails without it (hardcoded 0, not just an assumption)

confirmed reachability all the way to the real production report types (SystemizeReport.graph, WorkPrepareReport.graph) via `atlas-cli systemize` against this repository's own real, large-scale self-census (33,253 real evidence records), not only a small synthetic fixture
confirmed no other `GraphSummary` construction site or hardcoded schema-string consumer existed that this fix could have silently missed

cargo test --workspace.totals: 289 adapter, 3 apps/cli, 165 core (+1 net), 73 runtime -- 530 total, 0 failed

recensus_scope_after_promotion: no prior CLOSED/EXTINCT conclusion is affected

the same investigating agent also found and explicitly did NOT treat as its top finding a lower-confidence, currently-unexercised inconsistency in the docs-audit frontmatter pipeline (a doc that opens `---` frontmatter but never closes it would be counted toward canonical_frontmatter_total without any fields actually being parsed) -- confirmed no such file exists in this repository's own real `.atlas` tree today, named as a candidate for a future generation if that shape is ever demonstrated in real input, not acted on here
RepoAudit.ready's own derivation was checked and confirmed to correctly fold in every one of RepoAudit's sibling fields -- no gap found there
overall_verdict: MATERIALIZED AND VERIFIED. `GraphSummary.evidence_total` closes the exact regression this session's own earlier `EngineeringGraph.evidence` fix left behind: the lighter-weight summary type embedded in the two most-consumed report types (`SystemizeReport`, `WorkPrepareReport`) now carries a real evidence count instead of silently showing none. Confirmed the fix's own test genuinely fails without it, and confirmed real, large-scale data (33,253 records) flows through the actual production pipeline end-to-end. Full workspace suite (530 tests) passing, gate_ready true.
